name: stock_bt_callback_descriptor

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.043 IDB sub_C70B058 passes off_2CD4A744 to sub_C3AF3E8. The descriptor contains 17 callback words; slot 5 is the Thumb callable address of sub_C709E90 gap_pair_request_callback. sub_C3A96EC stores the descriptor in word 1 of the returned 8-byte registration node.

notes: Static stock descriptor used as the copy source for the resident pair-request filter mirror.
